user.title: Bitpanda Setup
user.description: Enter your Bitpanda API key. Create one at [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}) with these permissions: Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read). Trading is not needed. Permissions cannot be added to an existing key later.

currency.title: Select Currency
currency.description:
Select the currency used for all prices and wallet values.

⚠️ This setting cannot be changed later. To use a different currency, you will need to remove and re-add the integration.

After setup, you can configure wallets and price tracking via the integration options.

reauth_confirm.title: New Bitpanda API key needed
reauth_confirm.description: Bitpanda rejected the stored API key. It may have expired, or it predates the permissions this version needs. Create a new key at [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}) with Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read), and paste it here. Your tracked assets and sensors are kept.

reconfigure.title: Replace Bitpanda API key
reconfigure.description: Paste a new key from [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}). It needs Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read). Your tracked assets and sensors are kept.

error.invalid_auth: Bitpanda rejected this API key. Check that it was copied completely and that it has at least one of the required permissions.
error.missing_scopes: This API key is missing permissions: {missing_scopes}. Permissions cannot be added to an existing key — create a new one with Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read).
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

asset_category.title: Add price tracker

add_asset.title: Add price tracker
add_asset.description: Choose one or more assets. Type to search by name, symbol or ISIN.

add_wallet.title: Add wallet
add_wallet.description: Choose one or more assets you hold. Type to search.
